mathematical_clarifications: A fixed orthogonal rotation preserves empirical mean norm and does not imply Gaussian coordinate independence.
The source's Gaussian mid-quantile levels +/-0.67449 sigma differ from zero-threshold MSE-optimal conditional means +/-sqrt(2/pi) sigma.
The implementation's refined ranking score includes a query-only norm constant; this is checked against Chapter 5 and code, not copied from the simplified manuscript score.
